name: devpulse-ai
description: AI-powered production error monitoring and debugging for developers.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix sdk install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix sdk run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix sdk run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix sdk run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix sdk test
